svg.aria-label: Moonglade: the notch panel, captured from the running app, hanging from the top of the display and listing four live coding agent sessions with their provider tile, status, title, project, branch or pipeline step, and elapsed time. Below it the moon throws its glade across the sea, and on that water the collapsed bar, also captured from the app, carries a count for running sessions, a green dot and count for sessions waiting at the prompt, and a count and red dot for sessions that need you.
svg.title: Moonglade

g.text: A quiet indicator for your coding agents.
